event_name: Document 50 Date 03 November 2019 Time 13:30 2019 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 31 October - 3 November 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Incident between car 23 and car 55 in turn 1.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 2 of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, and determined that no driver was wholly or predominantly to blame, noting this was a first turn, first lap incident.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 23 Incident With Car 55 In Turn 1
